visual_thesis: Managed routing sends a model request among hosts, but marketplace traffic cannot stand in for enterprise adoption. At 320px distinguish the active network from the disconnected population boundary; full size shows provider selection and bounded retry.
mechanism_metaphor: One continuous open network topology. At upper-left a model-request tile enters a large central triangular router junction. Three differently shaped provider stations span the right side, each with a request inlet and response outlet but no logo or screen. Exactly three arrows: request tile to router, router to upper host, and conditional retry from upper host to lower host along the outer right edge. The third host is connected with a nondirectional availability guide only. Below-left a separate outlined population aperture contains mixed blank workload specimens and stays disconnected from the request route. Fourteen parts: request specimen, model-selection inset, router inlet, selection junction, price facet, speed facet, reliability facet, upper-host inlet, upper-host outlet, alternate-host inlet, spare-host profile, retry arc, traffic-population aperture and distinct enterprise-population outline. Do not encode any statistical share as area or line thickness.
